supportingSources.label: Skill Shot Speakeasy rules and strategy
Pinballorama Speakeasy rules and restoration notes

strategy.overview: Speakeasy rewards ordered card sequences and long bonus management. Complete the top 5-6-7-8-9 Hearts in sequence for two added balls; an out-of-sequence light can be cancelled at the end of the ball for 25,000 points each. Flip the center 10-through-Ace Spades in sequence for another added ball. Completing either five-card group in any order lights Bonus X, while four passes through the right Joker lane add a ball. The left and right saucers spin the roulette wheel, whose result can add points, add a ball, or subtract a ball.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the top 5-6-7-8-9 Hearts in sequence for two added balls. Flip the center 10-through-Ace Spades in sequence for another added ball. Completing either five-card group in any order advances Bonus X, and four right-lane Jokers add a ball. The side saucers spin the roulette wheel, which can also subtract a ball.
strategy.summary: Prioritize ordered Hearts and Spades while the sequence is clean, use the Joker lane for repeatable added-ball progress, and build Bonus X before accepting repeated roulette risk.

quickInfo.name: Joker Added Ball
quickInfo.summary: Light four Jokers in the right lane.

steps.text: Collect top Hearts 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 in the active sequence order for two added balls.
Flip the center Spades 10, Jack, Queen, King, and Ace in sequence for another added ball.
Use any-order completions of either five-card group to advance Bonus X, then build bonus toward its 119,000 maximum.
Use the right saucer to feed the Joker lane when safe; four lit Jokers award an added ball.

alternatives.title: Repair the Hearts sequence
alternatives.when: Use this at ball end when one or more out-of-sequence Hearts would block the next ordered completion.

steps.text: Use the Sacrifice option while the out-of-sequence light flashes.
Spend 25,000 points per cancelled light to restore the sequence route.
Complete the Hearts and Spades groups in any order to climb the multiplier ladder.
Preserve ordered sequence opportunities and Joker progress for added balls while building bonus.

machineSetup: Check the Hearts sequence direction, maximum balls, Special and Extra Ball awards, roulette add/subtract behavior, chip threshold, and Bonus X carryover.
Test all five top Hearts, five flyaway Spades and reset, Sacrifice button, both saucers, roulette wheel and sensors, Joker lane, spinner, bonus lamps, and ball-count display.

techniques.name: Post Catch
techniques.instruction: Settle a return on the flipper post before choosing a narrow top rollover or the flyaway target needed next in sequence.

cautions.issue: Roulette can subtract a ball, and tilting does not cancel the end-of-ball spin once it begins.
cautions.response: Treat roulette as controlled variance, not the default route when ordered cards or Joker progress are available.
